_comment: The perf rubric: the bands' thresholds and the letter rules. The single source for tools/perf/grade.py, tools/perf/grade.ts (the site computes the letter from a summary with it) and the test page (perf.js, to stop the ladder). docs/perf.md cites each source. Change on purpose, with the docs and the tests (test/grade-cases.json).
_protocol: The measurement protocol these rules apply to (tools/perf/page/tiers.js PROTOCOL): the pages, the swipes, the update rate, the windows and how the runner reads them. A summary from another protocol can't be graded with this file: re-measure.

frame_p95_ms.source: web.dev RAIL (16 ms frame budget); Android vitals slow frame (> 16 ms). One and two frames at 60 Hz, plus 0.5 ms slack

frame_jank_pct.source: good: same as p95 within budget (derived); poor: Play Console 'excessive slow frames' (> 50% over 16 ms)

frame_frozen_pct.source: Android vitals frozen frame (> 700 ms); poor: Play Console 'excessive frozen frames' (> 0.1%); good 0%: project choice

load_ms.source: Core Web Vitals LCP bounds (good <= 2.5 s, poor > 4 s), applied to each reference dashboard from navigation start to settled (the first frame followed by 750 ms of quiet, after the load event). Settled is at or after the largest paint, so this is stricter than LCP

inp_ms.source: Core Web Vitals INP (good <= 200 ms, poor > 500 ms), taps on each reference dashboard's toggle

start_ms.source: app process start to engine ready (GeckoView's own first PageStart). poor: Android vitals' excessive cold start bound (>= 5 s), which vitals apply to TTID. good <= 2.5 s: project choice (LCP's bound)

js_burst_ms.source: project choice: one state burst fits in a frame; poor past RAIL's 50 ms input budget

grade._comment: The letter. A page is at a level when each task's band is one the level accepts. The first letter whose every page need holds is the grade, else the fallback. A restart in start_cap.band caps the letter at start_cap.letter (never raises it). Frames bands (scroll, updates) are each run's band (the worst of frame_p95_ms, frame_jank_pct, frame_frozen_pct), then the median band of the runs, the worse middle for an even count. Tap, load and start band the median of the runs.

letters.meaning: a good wall panel even for large dashboards
a good wall panel for typical dashboards; large ones stay fluid
a good wall panel for typical dashboards
a good wall panel for light dashboards

fallback.meaning: not a good wall panel, even for light dashboards
